verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API with Bearer-token auth and an MCP integration guide for building custom clients/agents, but there is no evidence of official SDKs or client libraries (Python/JS/etc.); a probe for an OpenAPI spec also returned 404s across all likely paths, suggesting no generated/official SDK exists. missing for 10: official language SDKs, published OpenAPI/spec file, independent confirmation of SDK usage.
